### [MSc Thesis: Turning CO₂ into Useful Chemicals](project/msc-thesis/index.qmd){.stretched-link}
A new carbon-nanotube tandem catalyst converting CO₂ into cyclic organic carbonates under mild conditions (University of Warsaw, 2026).

### [MEng Thesis: Real-time Bacterial Counting](project/realtime-bacteria/index.qmd){.stretched-link}
Pre-treatment methods that remove interfering organic matter so bacteria in wastewater can be counted in real time (Nagasaki University, 2020).
:::

### [BEng Thesis: Advanced Oxidation for Wastewater Reuse](project/bachelor-thesis/index.qmd){.stretched-link}
